title: AgentLink
description: A one-way permission for agents of one template to call agents of another (PRD section 8.1, FR-1003). Without a link, calls are denied. Release 1: links between Muistamo-hosted templates only; links to external A2A agents are release 2.

to.description: The called agents. The link never allows calls the other way.

allowedSkills.description: Skills of the called agent the caller may use.

dataClasses.description: Data classes a call may carry. A call carrying any other class is denied.

actFor.description: same-user (the default): the called agent acts with the calling human's own access. service: it acts as itself.

maxDelegationDepth.description: The deepest point in a delegation chain at which this call is allowed. 1 (the default) means direct calls only: the called agent may not pass the work on.

rateLimit.description: For example 60/min. Stored, but not yet evaluated: it needs the gateway's counters.
